2946-4871-5670-5708.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
2946-4871-5670-5708.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-5670-5708.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Vein Ripper and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

728-3249-3621-6723.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-3621-6723.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for {0} that dies on enter

1957-2530-6823--203.easyPrerequisites: You either have at least 2 life or {B} available.
1957-2530-6823--203.description:
Cast the creature card from your hand for {0}. The creature enters, then immediately dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the creature enters, Carnival of Souls and Aunt May trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls ability, adding {B} and losing 1 life.
Resolve the Aunt May ability, gaining at least 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

1479-2841-7885-8099.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Prismatic Vista.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-7885-8099.description:
Fetch a land using Prismatic Vista.
When the fetched land enters, Down in the Valley and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Down in the Valley trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Down in the Valley triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

560-2292-4550-7920.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2292-4550-7920.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities.
Repeat.

275-5078-6259.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Samut.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Transplant Theorist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Transplant Theorist trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

1999-3263-4131-7340.easyPrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
1999-3263-4131-7340.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding at least two mana which you can spend to activate Master Transmuter due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Basalt Monolith from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sewer-veillance Cam from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Sewer-veillance Cam from the battlefield to your hand, putting Basalt Monolith from your hand onto the vattlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam leaves the battlefield, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Repeat.

1479-3478-3604.description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Cadric (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Dimir Aqueduct onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Dimir Aqueduct onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

1619-4605-5542-5686-6135.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-5686-6135.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Aarakocra Sneak from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Aarakocra Sneak enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Aarakocra Sneak.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Aarakocra Sneak that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Aarakocra Sneak token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Aarakocra Sneak token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Aarakocra Sneak that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Aarakocra Sneak trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-5686-6135.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

3213-5759-7711.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
3213-5759-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Screaming Nemesis indestructible using Boromir.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Screaming Nemesis.
Screaming Nemesis triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
3213-5759-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2116-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Spiteful Squad.
When Spiteful Squad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
2116-5256-6972.notes: When Spiteful Squad dies with a +1/+1 counter on it, that counter can be placed onto another creature. If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, it will be removed, allowing it to be returned via persist.

549-3259-5953-7297.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
549-3259-5953-7297.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
549-3259-5953-7297.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

392-4771-5660.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {1}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}
Repeat.

3693-6774-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Walking Ballista triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Loading Zone.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
3693-6774-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

1651-1770-5967-6754-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-1770-5967-6754-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-1770-5967-6754-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers twice due to Elesh Norn, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

14-147-413.description:
Cast Reincarnation by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Reincarnation, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Reincarnation.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Reincarnation triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities from step 5.

1170-1329-2478-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1170-1329-2478-4068.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

392-3532-3761-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
392-3532-3761-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Crusher.
Repeat.

2034-4659-5003-6644.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise, adding {C}{C}.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Treasure, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Extra Turn Spell - GY on Resolution

1018-5256-6490--88.notablePrerequisites:
You have enough mana available each turn to cast the extra turn spell and enough mana each extra turn to cast Skullwinder.
You have not cast a spell using Kotis
1018-5256-6490--88.description:
Cast the extra turn spell by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your extra turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Skullwinder, causing you to mill cards equal to Skullwinder's power.
Cast Skullwinder from your graveyard by paying its mana cost and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, ensuring not to exile the extra turn spell.
When Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the extra turn spell from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

3617-6333-6334.manaNeeded: {U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
3617-6333-6334.description:
Cast Time Walk from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Vanishing by paying {U}{U}, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
During your extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat.

1789-4875-5147-5649.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
1789-4875-5147-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

372-864-1567.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Momentary Blink exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Eternal Witness exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Momentary Blink.
372-864-1567.description:
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Eternal Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Eternal Witness trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Momentary Blink from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Momentary Blink.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Eternal Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1987-2104-4423-4823.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-2104-4423-4823.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Timeless Witness.
When Timeless Witness and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.

1849-3372-4050-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
1849-3372-4050-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {1}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

2178-3523-4102.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
2178-3523-4102.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

307-1474-3542.notablePrerequisites:
Nezumi Prowler and Palinchron do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Nezumi Prowler or Palinchron.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{B}.
307-1474-3542.description:
Declare Palinchron and Nezumi Prowler as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Nezumi Prowler from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is tapped and attacking.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Nezumi Prowler's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{B} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Nezumi Prowler onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Palinchron tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

4944-5106.description:
Activate Crypt Rats by paying {0}.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

628-3385-4907.description:
Cast Tatterkite by paying {3}.
When Tatterkite enters the battlefield, Aether Flash triggers, dealing 2 damage to Tatterkite.
Tatterkite dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Tatterkite's undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with zero +1/+1 counters on it due to its ability.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo creates a mandatory infinite loop that will draw the game if it is not interacted with.

186-3076-4474-4639.notablePrerequisites:
Sleep-Cursed Faerie does not have summoning sickness, and does not have a stun counter on it.
Paradise Mantle attached to Sleep-Cursed Faerie.
186-3076-4474-4639.description:
Activate Sleep-Cursed Faerie by tapping it, adding {U}.
Sleep-Cursed Faerie triggers, causing you to loot.
Activate Sleep-Cursed Faerie by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

567-859-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
Splinter Twin attached to Lurking Roper.
567-859-4702.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
When the Lurking Roper token enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Each Lurking Roper you control triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.

262-3459-3868.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Battered Golem.
Battered Golem does not have summoning sickness.
262-3459-3868.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, creating three 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping the Elementals, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
